children.name: text
children.text: How Gameplane compares

children.name: text
children.text: Pterodactyl and CubeCoders AMP are control panels; Agones is a Kubernetes operator library — not a direct competitor, but a reference point for teams building on Kubernetes primitives.

children.name: dimension
children.text: Deployment/runtime model

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Combined Kubernetes install or standalone panel on Docker Compose; game workloads use Kubernetes CRDs and a controller-runtime operator, from k3s to multi-node clusters. [PRE-V1]

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Self-hosted Panel with PHP/MySQL/Redis dependencies; Wings backend manages Docker containers.

children.name: amp
children.text: Web-based control panel supporting Windows (native) and Linux (Debian 10+).

children.name: agones
children.text: Kubernetes-native library extending K8s with GameServer/Fleet CRDs.

children.name: dimension
children.text: Scaling & auto-sleep

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Opt-in idle auto-sleep with configurable wake windows, manual wake button, or wake-on-connect. Minecraft/Terraria full protocol support; others use packet heuristics. [optional]

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Multi-node support with cron-based power scheduling; no dedicated idle/auto-sleep feature.

children.name: amp
children.text: Instance Automatic Sleep feature; multi-server architecture with controller managing instances.

children.name: agones
children.text: Fleet autoscaling via buffer/webhook strategies; no idle/sleep state.

children.name: dimension
children.text: Inbound connectivity (NAT traversal, relay)

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Integrated frp, Tailscale, playit relay sidecars; playit mappings user-managed via playit.gg account. [optional; disabled by default]

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: No integrated relay sidecars; manual proxy/port forwarding configuration required.

children.name: amp
children.text: not publicly documented (checked 2026-09-02)

children.name: agones
children.text: No relay or NAT traversal features documented.

children.name: dimension
children.text: Backup and restore

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Restic snapshots to S3-compatible storage; on-demand or cron-scheduled via BackupSchedule; one-click restore.

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Wings (local, default) or S3-compatible backup drivers; cron scheduling and on-demand backups.

children.name: amp
children.text: not publicly documented (checked 2026-09-02)

children.name: agones
children.text: not applicable (Agones is a Kubernetes operator library)

children.name: dimension
children.text: Access control & authentication

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Local argon2id + OIDC (Keycloak, Authentik, Google, Okta, Entra ID); three built-in roles (admin/operator/viewer); custom roles supported.

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: 2FA configurable per account or admin-only; subuser management via Artisan CLI.

children.name: amp
children.text: Role-based access control; OIDC single-sign-on in Advanced Edition.

children.name: agones
children.text: not applicable (Agones is a Kubernetes operator library)

children.name: dimension
children.text: Game template distribution

children.name: gameplane
children.text: OCI bundles via ModuleSource (git/http/oci/local/upload); optional cosign signature verification per source. 29 ready-to-use templates shipped.

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Community eggs repository (eggs.pterodactyl.io) with nests and custom egg creation support.

children.name: amp
children.text: Customizable templates framework; community-contributed templates available via external repositories.

children.name: agones
children.text: not applicable (Agones is a Kubernetes operator library)

children.name: dimension
children.text: Multi-tenancy & multi-cluster

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Remote registration via Cluster CRDs (combined) or SQL (standalone); central user grants; remote Pod logs and PTY; optional private gateway for agent operations. [gateway optional]

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Single Panel managing multiple nodes; no documented remote cluster or cross-cluster streaming.

children.name: amp
children.text: Multi-server management via controller architecture; multi-tenancy not supported in AMP 2 (planned for AMP 3).

children.name: agones
children.text: Multi-cluster allocation via GameServerAllocationPolicy; allocator service with mTLS authentication.

children.name: Target operator scope (self-hosted vs. managed SaaS)
dimension
children.text: Target operator scope (self-hosted vs. managed SaaS)

children.name: gameplane
children.text: Self-hosted only; panel runs on Docker Compose or Kubernetes, while games require Kubernetes (k3s, kubeadm, managed services); no managed SaaS offering.

children.name: pterodactyl
children.text: Self-hosted only; requires Linux system capable of running Docker containers.

children.name: amp
children.text: Self-installed on user hardware (Windows or Linux); no managed SaaS version.

children.name: agones
children.text: Self-hosted operator software; runs anywhere Kubernetes can run.

children.name: text
children.text: Why Kubernetes-native matters

children.name: text
children.text: The operator handles everything a cluster admin expects from a K8s controller — declarative reconciliation, owner references, leader election. Advanced users can bypass the dashboard entirely and manage Gameplane with kubectl apply.

children.name: text
children.text: Gameplane itself is open-source, licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later — see the license on GitHub.
